what_this_is: The Workshop rows for tools/read-and-write-mail: one container row per mail job (find a mailbox, search, read, organize, trash and restore mail and conversations, keep and send drafts, set a signature), each taking provider, an id of read-data/mail-providers.json, and running as the account its input's connection names. The provider's connection kind and key renewal are the row's by_input variants, derived from the provider rows (test/mail-tools.test.mjs); the provider's wire format is one adapter file behind its row.

payload.label: Find a mailbox's address
payload.job: Find which address a connected mail account belongs to, and where its mail stands now (cursor: the point list-new-mail goes on from).
payload.description: Find which address a connected mail account belongs to, and where its mail stands now (cursor: the point list-new-mail goes on from). Takes provider (an id of read-data/mail-providers.json) and connection (the person's account of that provider, by its handle only: {connection_id}). Runs as that account with the key the person's vault holds for it; the engine hands the key to this run alone and it is placed only in the request to the provider's own host, never shown. Answers the provider-neutral rows of read-data/neutral.mjs, never the provider's own payload. A provider that does not offer it says so in words.

connection_id.description: service_connection:<vendor> or service_connection:<vendor>:<account>, as the person's connections list it

connected_at.description: When that account was connected, so a reconnected account is a new one (not read by the run)
